mods.name: fables
mods.description: Claude Fables: turns what the agent is doing into little animated cartoons above the prompt, written live by Sonnet or Haiku.
mods.author: henrik-thevibe

mods.name: flightdeck
mods.description: Flightdeck: a live agent dashboard for Claude Code. Main model vitals, an on-call architect, every permission check, subagent cards and swimlanes, a turn receipt and a session log, all from real session events
mods.author: Stephen Casella

mods.name: clawd-spinner
mods.description: Clawd acts out the spinner's word above it while Claude works: cooking for Sautéing, dancing for Vibing, pacing for Pondering, 11 acts across all 179 words.
mods.author: Sai Rudra

mods.name: usage-meter
mods.description: Model, context window and rate-limit (5h / 7d) braille meters in a band above the prompt
mods.author: kawase1295

mods.name: mindful-claude
mods.description: Guided breathing exercises above the prompt while Claude works: coherent, box, 4-7-8 and the physiological sigh, four animation styles, and the spinner reads the breath. Appears when Claude starts, disappears when Claude answers. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.
mods.author: Anthony

mods.name: cache-ttl-timer
mods.description: A prompt-cache countdown in the prompt footer, beside the model and effort: how long until your next message has to re-cache the whole conversation.
mods.author: Seongje Hong

mods.name: cold-cache-guard
mods.description: Asks what to do before Claude Code re-sends a large conversation whose prompt cache has expired: on a cold resume, and on the first prompt after an idle spell.
mods.author: Mediavee

mods.name: exam-gate
mods.description: Before Claude calls a task done, run your checklist. Fail means Claude is sent back to fix it; repeated failure trips a breaker and hands control back to you.
mods.author: swei99386-alt

mods.name: context-relay
mods.description: Hands the work to a fresh session before a long context degrades the model, and carries on there.
mods.author: retrocodes12

mods.name: agent-narrator
mods.description: Watch the agent work: every step in plain English, with a live time-saved counter
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: agent-race
mods.description: Race Claude Code sessions on a task: live split-screen race track scoreboard
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: boss-fight
mods.description: Failing tests spawn a pixel boss; every run that fixes tests lands a hit, zero failures is a KO with loot
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: burn-meter
mods.description: Live session cost odometer above the prompt: a burning fuse, real-world comparisons, threshold alerts
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: code-pet
mods.description: A pixel pet that lives in a pane and reacts to what Claude does: eats on tool calls, gets sick on failures, panics on rm -rf, sleeps when idle, evolves as you ship
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: inbox-alerts
mods.description: Gmail + Slack alerts inside Claude Code: toasts, status count, and an Alerts pane
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: inner-monologue
mods.description: A pane of Claude's dry inner thoughts about your session, typed out live
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: launch-codes
mods.description: Dangerous Bash commands need launch codes: red alert pane, siren, a code to arm and a LAUNCH to fire
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: session-wrapped
mods.description: Spotify Wrapped for a Claude Code session: an animated stat reveal and a shareable PNG card
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: sportscaster
mods.description: Live TV play-by-play of your Claude Code session, spoken aloud with crowd effects
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: swarm
mods.description: Mission control for subagents and agent teams: who is running, what each is doing, who spawned whom, who is talking to whom, and how they overlap
mods.author: OneWave AI

mods.name: claude-mermaid
mods.description: Mermaid diagrams in Claude Code: every ```mermaid block Claude writes is drawn as box art, in colour, right where the fence was in the transcript. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.
mods.author: Gal Elmalah

mods.name: claude-queue
mods.description: A prompt typed while Claude is working is held in a stack above the prompt instead of landing in the running turn, and sent once the turn ends. Reorder the stack, edit a row in place, send one first, remove one, flush the lot. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.
mods.author: Gal Elmalah

mods.name: cc-dino
mods.description: The T-rex from the browser's offline page, above the Claude Code prompt: jump cacti and duck birds while Claude works. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.
mods.author: Giovanni Borgogno

mods.name: cc-dino
mods.description: The Chrome offline dinosaur, above the Claude Code prompt. Jump the cacti and duck the pterodactyls while Claude works. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.
mods.author: manfye

mods.name: effort-guard
mods.description: Claude Code mod: context/token band, escalation signals and per-turn effort log.
mods.author: Stefano Chieli

mods.name: jev-guard
mods.description: Probability-scored guardrails for Claude Code: deny rule-breaking edits and unasked-for deploys, route your own docs into each prompt, and check the final answer against the turn's own evidence.
mods.author: Oguzhan Cakmak

mods.name: touch-map
mods.description: See which files Claude has listed, read, partially read, edited, created or deleted, as a tree and an activity map in a pane.
mods.author: y-hirakaw

mods.name: html-preview
mods.description: Shows HTML files Claude writes (or /preview <file>) like a browser: terminal-browser when installed, else a built-in Chrome-rendered pane
mods.author: JAICHANGPARK

mods.name: image-view
mods.description: See the images you paste into Claude Code: thumbnails above the prompt instead of bare [Image #1] tags
mods.author: Jarrod Watts

mods.name: rename-ja
mods.description: 引数なしの /rename で、会話内容から日本語のセッション名を生成する。
mods.author: tomatoaiu

mods.name: model-effort-shortcuts
mods.description: Keyboard shortcuts that step the reasoning effort level and the model up and down; the footer shows what each request uses
mods.author: Richard Kuo

mods.name: pi-agent-for-claude
mods.description: pi agent for claude: a `pi` subagent type whose model steps run the pi CLI, so pi subagents and agent-team teammates live in Claude Code's own agent UI, streamed live.
mods.author: Fazal Ali

mods.name: plan-progress
mods.description: Live plan progress bars above the Claude Code prompt: stages, steps, a pixel fill and soft sounds for decision, error and done
mods.author: Kirill Serditov

mods.name: cc-pr-tracker
mods.description: Watch GitHub PRs from a Claude Code session: merge state, review and required checks above the prompt, with alerts when they change
mods.author: Seza Akgün

mods.name: prompt-jump
mods.description: A bar above the prompt input with a tick for every prompt of the session; hover to read one, click to jump to it
mods.author: ruanss4

mods.name: pumpfun-utilities
mods.description: Your open pump.fun positions in a pane while Claude works, and a markdown trade journal that fills itself. Read-only, no keys, no trading
mods.author: KamiFin

mods.name: better-ask-picker
mods.description: Ask the user a question in a dedicated pane: show every option on one screen with a summary, single or multi-select, no 4-option limit.
mods.author: Takashi Ogishima

mods.name: tts
mods.description: 在每段回复下加一个🔊按钮，用火山引擎豆包语音（知性女声 2.0）流式朗读，可暂停、继续、从头念、倍速

mods.name: cache-keeper
mods.description: Keeps a big chat's prompt cache warm, warns before an expensive cold restart, shows every local chat on one board (/board), and hands a chat off to a fresh one (/handoff)
mods.author: Nate Herk

mods.name: collision-guard
mods.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another open chat changed in the last 30 minutes: Proceed, Move to a worktree, or Cancel (/guard)
mods.author: Nate Herk

mods.name: goal-meter
mods.description: A progress bar for /goal built from Claude's own task plan: tasks done out of the plan, elapsed time, an ETA at the goal's own pace, and every chat's goal in /goals
mods.author: Nate Herk

mods.name: recording-mode
mods.description: /rec before you record: masks keys, personal details, and business figures on screen and keeps private files closed (/rec strict, /rec off, /rec config)
mods.author: Nate Herk

mods.name: session-notes
mods.description: Project notes in .claude/notes.md: live dev servers, recent artifacts and pinned links, in a side panel and with /notes.
mods.author: udaaff

mods.name: cache-timer
mods.description: Counts down to when the prompt cache expires, so you can send the next message before the whole conversation has to be cached again
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: change-ledger
mods.description: Lists the files this session edited in a pane (/changes), with line counts and who edited them, beside the git working tree
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: ci-watch
mods.description: Watches GitHub Actions in a band above the prompt after Claude pushes, opens a PR or pushes a tag: a progress bar per run, then pass or fail; optionally flags failed scheduled workflows at start
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: compact-keeper
mods.description: Saves each compaction's summary, with the files edited before it, to ~/.claude/handoffs so the context before /compact can be recovered
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: guardrails
mods.description: Blocks Cloudflare write commands, attribution lines in commits and PRs, and claude/ branch names
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: image-peek
mods.description: Shows the images you paste: thumbnails above the prompt, and larger pictures under each sent message in the chat; needs a kitty-graphics terminal such as Ghostty
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: loop-guard
mods.description: Tells the model, out of the user's sight, to stop when the same call fails twice with the same error
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: pin-board
mods.description: Pins standing notes with /pin that Claude keeps following after /compact and /clear; shows them in one row above the prompt or as a counter, and keeps them per folder with --keep
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: search-meter
mods.description: Counts the model's searches and colors each one: green found first try, yellow found after misses, red found nothing
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: secret-guard
mods.description: Keeps secrets out of the conversation: hides API keys and private keys before the model or the transcript sees them, and blocks reads of credential files and commands that print secrets
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: session-meter
mods.description: Shows a live session pane (/ctx): context breakdown, usage limits with pace, tool calls and model requests; sends the model a one-time note when limits or context cross a threshold
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: show-me
mods.description: Draws the mermaid diagrams of each answer as images in a pane (/show-me); needs mmdc and a kitty-graphics terminal such as Ghostty
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: turn-footer
mods.description: Turns the line under each answer into a turn summary (tools, requests, tokens, cache hit) and shows the running tool in the spinner
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: turn-timeline
mods.description: Draws the current turn as a timeline in a pane (/timeline): model requests and tool calls per loop, where the time went, and the slowest steps
mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: leftovers
mods.description: Keeps a ledger of what Claude left running or lying around on your machine and servers
mods.author: Gary

mods.name: plan-bar
mods.description: Live progress bars above the prompt for multi-step work: one row per plan, with stages, percent, waiting and failed colors, and sounds
mods.author: Gary

mods.name: secret-mask
mods.description: Mask token-like strings in tool output before they reach the conversation
mods.author: Gary

mods.name: shell-highlight
mods.description: Draws Bash and PowerShell tool calls with syntax-highlighted commands
mods.author: Turbo-Thorschten

mods.name: spell-bar
mods.description: An animated effort bar for Claude Code: Clawd casts Avada Kedavra at six ranks, one per effort level from low to ultracode, with Voldemort looming behind.
mods.author: powerofjinbo

mods.name: cc-arcade
mods.description: Games above the Claude Code prompt (snake, Tetris, 2048, Minesweeper, Flappy, Pong, typing test, Space Invaders, Doom) plus a pet that grows as Claude tests, commits and edits. Clones of the genre, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tetris Holding, Taito, Atari or id Software. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.
mods.author: Seza Akgün

mods.name: tool-trim-compaction
mods.description: compaction で古いツール呼び出しと結果を消し、発言は原文のまま残す。削減が足りなければ標準の要約に回す
mods.author: okamyuji

mods.name: usage-report
mods.description: Shows context fill, 5-hour and weekly quota, and session cost on the status line under the prompt, with warnings near your limits.
mods.author: Schweem

mods.name: usage-wrapup
mods.description: When your plan usage gets low, tells every running agent to wrap up before the limit cuts it off.
mods.author: Kevin Koch

mods.name: agent-radar
mods.description: One live line above the prompt per running subagent: time, tool count and what it's doing. /radar shows every agent and its messages.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: blast-radius
mods.description: Holds risky Bash commands and shows what they would change before they run.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: browser-lanes
mods.description: Shows if this session has a Playwright browser and who holds it. /browser clean closes leftover browsers. A subagent that wants the browser waits until the one using it is done.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: glance
mods.description: One line above the prompt with what needs you: next meeting, PRs, Linear issues and Slack DMs. /glance lists them all.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: md-preview
mods.description: Shows the Markdown files Claude edits, rendered like GitHub, in a pane next to the chat. Before and after side by side. /md opens it.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: merge-gate
mods.description: Holds `gh pr merge` until CI passes and one Codex review (OpenAI's luna model) has run. A PR line above the prompt, and /gate shows the PR's status.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: mission-control
mods.description: /mission opens a live map of the main agent, its subagents and every tool call, plus a code map of the files they touch.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: next-steps
mods.description: After each turn, 2 or 3 likely next prompts above the prompt. Press 1, 2 or 3 in an empty prompt to draft one, 0 to dismiss.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: reels
mods.description: YouTube Shorts in a terminal pane: plays while Claude works, pauses when Claude is done.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: replay-theater
mods.description: Step through the last turn's file edits, one diff at a time.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: rulebook-guard
mods.description: Writing and git rules: replaces em dashes in prose, and asks before git commit --amend, an unformatted push, or personal info in notes and commits.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: session-saver
mods.description: Names untitled sessions through unpause. /park saves where you left off, and a resumed session shows it.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: snake
mods.description: Snake in a pane while Claude works, paused when it's done. Opt-in, so nothing opens until /snake.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: token-weather
mods.description: A live forecast of the context window, with a prompt-cache countdown, drawn above the prompt.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: usage-meter
mods.description: Your plan's 5-hour and 7-day usage as small bars above the prompt, with the reset countdown and the session's cost.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar

mods.name: where-am-i
mods.description: A live recap above the prompt: goal, doing now, waiting on you, next. /where for a longer one.
mods.author: Hamza Zafar
